laws.rule: In scenic areas, smoking, setting off fireworks or using fire in a fire-ban zone is banned (article 21). The management body gives a warning and orders it to stop.
laws.penalty_signal: Fine CNY 1,000 to 10,000 (about A$213 to A$2,133) in serious cases (article 51). (CNY at 4.6877 per A$1, RBA 30 Oct 2026.)
